settings.label: Training product
settings.value: HLTPAT010 Collect specimens for drugs of abuse testing

settings.label: Delivery
settings.value: 1-day face-to-face workshop, delivered on-site at your workplace, dates arranged directly with the team.

settings.label: Standards basis
settings.value: Developed to meet legislative requirements for drug testing under AS/NZS 4308 (urine) and AS 4760 (oral fluid), and applicable Commonwealth and State/Territory legislation.

settings.label: Learner requirements
settings.value: Minimum 18 years of age (proof of age or driver licence required). Basic language, literacy and numeracy skills to read workplace procedures and complete chain-of-custody documentation.

settings.label: Andatech provides
settings.value: Learning and assessment resources, plus any ongoing support a learner needs to complete the course.

settings.label: Your site provides
settings.value: Access to site procedures so training aligns with site rules, and a suitable room or area for practical training and assessment.

settings.label: Group size
settings.value: 1:8 to 1:10 face to face, 1:4 to 1:6 online

settings.heading: What is HLTPAT010?
settings.text: A nationally recognised unit of competency covering the skills and knowledge required to collect specimens for drugs-of-abuse testing.

settings.heading: Who issues my Statement of Attainment?
settings.text: METEX Solutions Pty Ltd — RTO 46448 — issues the Statement of Attainment to learners assessed as competent.

settings.heading: What is Andatech’s role?
settings.text: Andatech is an authorised third-party provider delivering specified services on behalf of METEX Solutions Pty Ltd.

settings.heading: Does completing the training make our workplace D&A program compliant?
settings.text: No single training course by itself guarantees that an organisation's workplace D&A program is compliant. Employers should consider their applicable legal, workplace, contractual, industrial, regulatory and site-specific requirements.

settings.heading: Do we need to purchase Andatech equipment?
settings.text: No. Purchasing Andatech products or services is not a condition of enrolment, assessment or certification unless a particular learner-supplied requirement is expressly identified in approved pre-enrolment information.
